hebrewText: הֲֽ/תִבְטַח בּ֭/וֹ כִּי רַ֣ב כֹּח֑/וֹ וְ/תַעֲזֹ֖ב אֵלָ֣י/ו יְגִיעֶֽ/ךָ

tokens.bdb: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
tokens.kjv: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).
tokens.explanation: rav — grande, muito, numeroso, abundante, ancião

tokens.bdb: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
tokens.kjv: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

tokens.bdb: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
tokens.kjv: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor)
